summary: Tree and pole PDF reports generated by the Python SDK can now include inspection frames from the job asset endpoint. Unavailable frames are omitted with a warning.
audience: Python SDK users who generate tree or pole reports with download_tree_report or download_pole_report.
customer_action: Upgrade to kanopy-ai 0.8.1 to get inspection imagery in generated reports. The API key needs job data download access for frames to be included.

api.assessment: Client method signatures, return values and supported Python versions are unchanged. download_tree_report and download_pole_report now fetch each frame imagePath (up to six embedded frames) from the documented job asset endpoint with the client's API key and organization header, on the configured API origin only. Earlier report implementations appended the server's /api/jobs/... link to the /api/v1 base path or fetched it without API credentials. This change resolves those links against the API origin and authenticates job asset requests. Captions now use an available text style. A redirect from the asset endpoint to object storage is followed on the credential-free client, and any imagePath that is not the job asset endpoint on the configured API scheme, host and port (other hosts, other API routes, dot segments) is still fetched without the API key or organization header. Asset reads use the existing GET retry policy, count toward the key's rate limit and usage like other API reads, and need resources:read plus job data download access to the job's organization. A frame that cannot be fetched (403, 404, cold storage 409, network error, or a redirect with a missing or empty Location header) is left out with a warning instead of failing the report. The bundled public contract snapshot is refreshed from the current API (adding the job asset and product updates operations, the audit events cursor and span circuit fields); it is test data read by the SDK contract tests, carried in the source distribution's tests but not installed with the package. No upload, export, pagination or other download behavior changes.

rollout: Takes effect for an integration only after kanopy-ai 0.8.1 is published to the package index and the integration upgrades. Merging bumps the package version so the release workflow tags v0.8.1; publication still requires the reviewed release approval. This SDK change uses the documented job asset endpoint and requires no server changes. No feature flag is introduced; merging source does not establish package availability.
data_effect: No stored data, job results or processing outputs change and no rerun is required. Reports regenerated with 0.8.1 can include inspection frames that earlier versions left out.
dependencies: Publication of kanopy-ai 0.8.1 through the reviewed release workflow.
